added_failures_note: both arms named by the reviewed run's baseline_suite and after_suite ran to their summary line and failed the same single id, tests/test_a_crashed_producer_is_restarted.py::test_repeated_crashes_reach_a_reported_limit (gate/second-base/base-chunk_00.log and gate/second-head/head-chunk_00.log, 1 failed / 65 passed either side), so the change adds no failing test; the wider nine-chunk arms in gate/base-suite-second.txt and gate/head-suite-second.txt carry the same one id and the same 8-of-9 EXIT=0 chunks.

findings.text: follow-on: the pointer fallback is reached only when the session has no registration file at all, so a session whose released registration remains on disk (release deliberately keeps the file, reckon/crew/follower_registration.py:404) still takes its grace from that registration and its lease, and a fresh dispatch on it can be swept within seconds -- exactly the defect the commit message claims to close; the new test's fresh session never registered, so this path is untested.

follow-on: `_pointer_activity_seconds` is a second implementation of "how long since this run last showed activity", which `_stream_quiet_seconds` already computes in this same module at reckon/crew/runs.py:3035 and `recovery_watch._quiet_clock_latest` recomputes at reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:954; the source index and the null semantics differ, so it is a near-neighbour rather than a textual clone, but a single owner for the quantity would stop the three drifting.

item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md; status complete, it records the test command and its result, three negative controls with their logs, both parity arms with the same single failure either side, and the ruff delta on the changed files.

justifications.reuse: `_pointer_activity_seconds` at reckon/crew/runs.py:3119 reimplements a quantity this module already computes in `_stream_quiet_seconds` at reckon/crew/runs.py:3035 and which reckons again in `recovery_watch._quiet_clock_latest` at reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:954; it neither extends nor wraps either, differing only in source index and null semantics.
